text: Oracle on the wastelands by the sea: [2]Like whirlwinds sweeping through the Negeb,it comes from the desert,from the fearful land. [AA]
A harsh vision has been announced to me:"The traitor betrays,the despoiler spoils. [AB]Go up, O Elam; besiege, O Media; [3]put an end to all its groaning!" [AC]
Therefore my loins are filled with anguish,pangs have seized me like those of a woman in labor;I am too bewildered to hear,too dismayed to look. [AD]
My mind reels,shuddering assails me;The twilight I yearned forhe has turned into dread. [AE]
They set the table,spread out the rugs;they eat, they drink. [4] [AF]Rise up, O princes,oil the shield!
For thus my Lord said to me:Go, station a watchman,let him tell what he sees.
If he sees a chariot,a pair of horses,Someone riding a donkey,someone riding a camel,Then let him pay heed,very close heed.
Then the watchman cried,"On the watchtower, my Lord,I stand constantly by day;And I stay at my postthrough all the watches of the night. [AG]
Here he comes—a single chariot,a pair of horses—He calls out and says,'Fallen, fallen is Babylon!All the images of her godsare smashed to the ground!'" [AH]
To you, who have been threshed,beaten on my threshing floor,What I have heardfrom the Lord of hosts,The God of Israel,I have announced to you. [AI]
Oracle on Dumah: [5]They call to me from Seir,"Watchman, how much longer the night?Watchman, how much longer the night?"
The watchman replies,"Morning has come, and again night.If you will ask, ask; come back again."
Oracle: in the steppe: [6]In the thicket in the steppe you will spend the night,caravans of Dedanites.
Meet the thirsty, bring them water,inhabitants of the land of Tema,greet the fugitives with bread. [AJ]
For they have fled from the sword,from the drawn sword;From the taut bow,from the thick of battle.
For thus the Lord has said to me: In another year, like the years of a hired laborer, [7] all the glory of Kedar shall come to an end.
Few of Kedar's stalwart archers shall remain, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has spoken.
